questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you a detour is 1,000 feet ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point upward, they are signaling a right turn. If you see this hand signal, adjust your driving accordingly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white rectangles with black markings that tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign tells drivers when it is safe to turn left. Wait for the left turn signal before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a railroad crossing ahead. Slow down when you see it. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must always let trains pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that traffic from the right will merge ahead. Be ready to let them in safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is coming up. Watch for cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be prepared for a sharp left turn ahead.
Watch for people crossing your path.
Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.
questions.explanation: This sign indicates that the traffic pattern or route will change due to work ahead. Follow the detour shown.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about work zones. This sign directs you to take a different route around the construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that parking in this area is not allowed. Your vehicle will be towed if you park here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is moving in both directions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you cannot enter. It is posted at the end of one-way streets and warns you not to enter from the wrong direction. Stop and turn around if you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign shows that a pedestrian crossing is ahead. Drive carefully and watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road will curve to the right and then to the left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down when you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Come to a full stop if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop completely. Look both ways and yield to other traffic before proceeding when it is safe.

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes moving in the same direction will soon become one lane. Be ready to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means the action is prohibited. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: On a vertical traffic signal, red is on top and green is on the bottom. On a horizontal signal, red is on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that a side road is coming up ahead. Be ready for traffic that may enter from that road.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a stop sign ahead.

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign marks a bicycle crossing or path. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles may cross the road or ride nearby.

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: Any eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop and look for pedestrians and other traffic before entering the intersection.
